name: Prismatic Geodes: Mini Blocks
description: Optional addon: mini blocks (decorative heads) for the 15 coloured Prismatic Geodes amethyst blocks, made to fit next to the Vanilla Tweaks Mini Blocks data pack. Requires Prismatic Geodes. Stonecut 1 block into 8 mini blocks. Purple is already in Vanilla Tweaks Mini Blocks. Head textures recoloured from the Vanilla Tweaks Mini Amethyst Block (https://vanillatweaks.net/).
